prompt:
Create one production ANIMATED CHARACTER SPRITE SHEET from the attached finalized combat master. Preserve THIS exact face, forest-green hair, proportions, modern black coat with silver trim and sleeve crest, emerald embroidered lining, trousers, boots, black/gold katana and black scabbard. Exact same natural adult anatomy; no chibi. Face/head/eyes keep the master's SCREEN-RIGHT direction, focused on the attack target, never turn toward the viewer. Same refined unified 2D anime/painterly rendering. Native genuine TRANSPARENT RGBA, no background, ground, shadows, dragon, aura or VFX.
LAYOUT: EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows, six equally sized SQUARE cells, chronological left-to-right then top-to-bottom, preferred3072x2048 or1536x1024. One complete full-body character per cell, fixed camera and consistent scale, all feet/coat/sword/scabbard inside its own cell with 12% EMPTY margin. No labels or cell lines. Make six real successive drawings, not translated duplicates. Keep upright torso unless the action requires a modest bend.
WEAPON RULE: One rigid katana and one black scabbard only; no mouth sword. In ready pose the grip points forward SCREEN RIGHT and scabbard trails behind SCREEN LEFT. The hand on the screen-right side of the gold guard wraps the diamond HANDLE; the other hand on the screen-left side grips SCABBARD THROAT. Match the master precisely; keep these same hands attached to their respective objects during movement. Guard, blade root and hilt remain perfectly continuous, no crooked parts, extra guard, long hilt, floating fingers or hidden contact. Normal gentle katana curve, never bent/kinked. Protect hand structure, sword and face more than decoration.
ACTION: SIX-FRAME QUIET BREATHING LOOP. Same upright ready stance in all six. 1 neutral ready,2 small inhalation chest rise,3 hair tips and coat tails flow gently,4 relaxed exhalation,5 cloth settles,6 returns toward frame1. Boots stay on same groundline. Both hands firmly remain around hilt and scabbard throat, only tiny motion; katana remains entirely sheathed except small collar gleam.
